name: GroupBy
description: Aggregate DataFrame columns grouped by one or more key columns (SQL GROUP BY with aggregate functions).
usage: Provide ``by`` (the grouping key columns) and ``columns`` (a mapping of column name to the aggregation function to apply). Each value may be a single function name or a list of function names. Functions must be one of the supported aggregations (see the ``aggFunc`` enum).

attributes.name: columns
attributes.description: Mapping of column name to the aggregation function (or list of functions) to apply, e.g. ``{"total_revenue": "sum", "avg_price": "mean"}``.

attributes.name: by
attributes.description: Column name(s) to group by, e.g. ``["region", "product"]``. Must exist in the input DataFrame.

attributes.name: by_replace_nan
attributes.description: Value used to replace NaN in the ``by`` columns before grouping. When omitted, missing values in grouping columns raise an error.

json_schema.title: GroupBy

columns.description: Column-to-aggregation mapping. Keys are columns present in the input DataFrame; each value is one aggregation function or a list of them.

by_replace_nan.description: Value used to replace NaN in the ``by`` columns before grouping. When omitted, missing values in grouping columns raise an error.

json_schema.description: Group the input DataFrame by ``by`` and aggregate the named ``columns``.

aggFunc.description: Supported aggregation function. Numeric-only functions coerce the column to numeric first; ``avg_first_last`` is a special function averaging the first and last value per group.
